title: euphrasia montana var. hirtella
intro: Euphrasia montana var. hirtella, commonly known as mountain eye-clover, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to support eye health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia montana var. hirtella are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Regular consumption of Euphrasia montana var. hirtella has been associated with improved eye health, reduced oxidative stress, and enhanced immune function.
